event.title: US Army Soldier Arrested in the UK on Suspicion of Espionage for Russia
event.canonical_title: US Army Soldier Arrested in the UK on Suspicion of Espionage for Russia
event.summary: A senior US Army soldier has been arrested in the UK on suspicion of espionage related to Russian intelligence activities. The arrest occurred near Gloucester, with both British and American officials involved in the investigation. Counterterrorism police are leading the probe into the soldier's alleged connections to Russia.

timeline.title: US Soldier Arrested in UK for Spying Taken into Military Custody
